story.text: Advanced Directives. These are legal documents that tell your care team and loved ones what medical treatment you want — or don't want — if you are ever unable to speak for yourself.

story.label: Documents on File
options: Durable Power of Attorney for Health Care
value: Durable Power of Attorney for Health Care
story.comments: Copies are with Dr. Clearly and with my daughter Maria.

story.text: POLST. A POLST translates your wishes into medical orders that follow you across care settings. It must be signed by a physician.

story.document_location: Bedside table drawer and Dr. Clearly's office.

story.text: Health Care Agent. This is the person you have chosen to make health care decisions on your behalf if you are unable to do so.
My Wishes. Use this section to record what matters most to you — quality of life, where you want to be cared for, and anything else you want your care team to know.

story.where_i_want_to_be: Home, if possible. Not a nursing facility.
story.what_matters_most: Being able to recognize my family and communicate with them.
story.religious_spiritual: I want a chaplain present. I pray daily and find it comforting.
story.other_wishes: I do not want to be kept alive by machines if there is no hope of recovery.
